summary: First Citizens BancShares filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for an offering of depositary shares, each a 1/100th interest in a share of Series F Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock with $100,000 liquidation preference per share ($1,000 per depositary share). Dividends are fixed-rate through September 15, 2031, then reset to five-year Treasury plus a spread; non-cumulative, perpetual, redeemable on or after September 15, 2031. Pricing, rate, and size are left blank. No exchange listing. This is a routine preferred capital raise, not a special situation.
